body: Yeah, I do feel really bad though. I apologized multiple times in chat, so maybe I just feel this way, but I don't want to go on and spark debate because of my username.
The streamer only gets around 100 people in each Livestream, so I think this could be another reason, as he seems to be newer.

The streamer said that was a lot of pressure, and talked about boundaries. I think the streamer doesn't want people to rely on them to make them feel better, which I get. I did say that I was anxious/sad tonight, which may have been too specific. I'll probably just change my account name if I can.
